why: Advice 1 puts conversion tracking first, uses one focused test cell, and ties success and stop rules to a breakeven CPA of 20,000 yen times the gross margin, which is internally consistent. Advice 2 has useful ideas such as the CPC back-calculation and splitting pre-trip from in-Japan audiences, but it presents assumptions like a 60% margin and a 50/50 gamble as if they were facts. It also spreads a small budget across roughly 8 test cells and sets a stop line of 15,000 yen, above its own breakeven CPA of 12,000 yen.
